title: Carry the caller auth context into human inbox contributor threads
summary: Fixes real regression where _HUMAN_INBOX_CONTRIBUTOR_EXECUTOR.submit ran contributor reads without caller contextvars context, causing owner_reads.approval_records to raise RuntimeError due to missing authorization contextvar in worker threads and degrading human inbox approval queue. Submits with contextvars.copy_context().run and stubs owner_reads.approval_owner.list_decisions in test fixture.

classification_of_test_changes.detail: Assertion that recovered human_inbox surface is not degraded previously failed with contributor_read_error ('Governance reads require the caller authorization') because thread pool lacked caller auth context. Fixed in production by passing contextvars.copy_context().run to executor.submit; test fixture stubs owner_reads.approval_owner.list_decisions.

Proves contributor thread receives request authorization both as call argument and in authorization.get() contextvar, and confirms live approval proposals appear in /bff/management/human-inbox data items.

acceptance_verification.criterion: Human inbox contributor reads run with the caller context so owner reads see caller authorization; live approval proposals appear in inbox; regression test proves contributor thread sees request authorization
Every test in the listed test files passes on the merged tree and no previously passing BFF test regresses
acceptance_verification.detail: All 4 tests in services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_management_read_timeout_and_capacity.py pass; test_bff_b3_human_inbox.py (5 passed) and test_bff_promotion_review_governance.py (11 passed) pass.

acceptance_verification.criterion: Each changed test expectation is classified in evidence as retired/stale/intended or real regression; no assertion weakened
acceptance_verification.detail: Zero assertions weakened; test_human_inbox_capacity_saturation_yields_immediate_degraded_response_and_recovers recovered expectation retained and satisfied by production fix.

acceptance_verification.criterion: No compressed code is used to meet the line budget
acceptance_verification.detail: Net production code change is +1 line in router.py (standard import contextvars and contextvars.copy_context().run), well within the 10 line budget.
